newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Seal says awaits clarification on highway.
newsitem.headline: Seal says awaits clarification on highway.

text.p: Malaysian timber and construction company Seal Incorporated Bhd said on Wednesday it was still awaiting government clarification on why it was deselected from a two-billion ringgit highway project.

"To date we have not received any reply from the Economic Planning Unit...as to whether the company's equity of 20 percent in the Konsortium Lapangan Terjaya Bhd (airport highway consortium) has been replaced with Bright Focus Sdn Bhd," said Seal.
Newspaper reports earlier in July said that Bright Focus, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Maju Holdings Sdn Bhd, would take Seal's place in the consortium.

The highway would start in Kuala Lumpur and extend through the new government administrative capital Putrajaya, and ending at the new Kuala Lumpur International Airport. Construction is expected to start this year and finish in 1999.
Seal shares were requoted on Wednesday after the company made the statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Tuesday. At 0804 GMT, the stock was up 22 cents to 3.86 ringgit.
